description: Screen a payment ENDPOINT (URL or domain) before calling it — the half that address screening cannot answer. In x402 the agent discovers a URL first, receives a 402, and only then learns where to pay: if that endpoint is spoofed, the payee address it hands back is freshly generated and appears on no sanctions list. Checks the hostname and its parent domains against phishing-domain intelligence plus hostname shape signals (bare IP, punycode homograph, deep subdomain nesting, free hosting). Returns clear | caution | risky | unknown with language-independent signal_keys. A clear verdict means no match was found, NOT that the endpoint is safe — freshly registered phishing hosts always precede any list. Use together with screen_address. Free, no API key.

lang.description: Language for human-readable fields. Defaults to English.

url.description: Full URL or bare domain of the payment endpoint, e.g. https://pay.example.com/x402 or pay.example.com

name: screen_endpoint

imitates.description: Present when the host imitates a known brand.

listed_as.description: Present when the host or a parent domain is on a phishing list: source, label, firstSeen, lastSeen, delistedAt.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code; table at https://oceanalt.com/api/contract.

risk.description: Rounded to 10 when detail_level is coarse.

signal_keys.description: Language-independent keys. Branch on these. Full list at https://oceanalt.com/api/contract.

signals.description: Human-readable. Do not branch on these.

verdict.description: clear means no match in the data held, not that it is safe. uncertain must never be treated as clear.

title: Screen a payment endpoint for phishing (free)
